reviews.text:
I love the team that works there, they are excellent professionals and wonderful human beings!
I not only felt that my animals were well treated in terms of medical care, but also that there was affection from both sides.
I feel that there is extra care from the team in meeting our needs and challenges.
The friendliness of the place and the people transforms the typically nervous environment for animals into a welcoming and joyful space.
Everything is explained to us in detail, and I was always informed of the reasons for any treatment/medication or food choice.
I have a lot of trust in the people who are there.
Excellent professionals and great human beings!
Excellent team, personal service, facilities, professionalism. I recommend them!

Thank you so much for all the care you've given my girls since they started being cared for by you! Always available, concerned and loving…

Dr. Inês, may there be more human beings like you…
Dr. João, thank you so much!
Rita, thank you so much for all the affection and care you give the girls!
Hugo, what a wonderful groomer!
Dr. Inês and her assistant Rita are amazing people. They treat our furry friends with so much love and care 😻 …
Impressive how friendly Dr. Inês, Rita, and Beatriz were, and the quality of their services was outstanding! Congratulations!
I was impressed with the service at this clinic! I recommend it 100%!
